description: This file defines the LeaveLeaveEntitlement entity class which models the relationship between leave entitlements and specific leave types within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping, getter and setter methods for its properties, and integrates a decorator trait.

classes.name: LeaveLeaveEntitlement
classes.description: An ORM-mapped entity class representing leave entitlement details associated with specific leave records, including properties for id, leave, entitlement, and length of days, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this leave entitlement record.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Retrieves the Leave entity associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlement
methods.description: Retrieves the LeaveEntitlement entity linked to this record.

methods.name: setEntitlement
methods.description: Links a LeaveEntitlement entity to this record.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Gets the number of days of leave entitlement.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days of leave entitlement.
